title: fix: resolve The List printing relationships in CSV converter
body:
## Summary
Fix PLST compound collector resolution and canonical printing grouping without card-specific exceptions. Sprint: converter maintenance (no sprint number assigned).

## User Impact
Preserves source compound numbers, outputs catalog-compatible seller fields, and exposes PLST_COMPOUND_COLLECTOR_UNRESOLVED with parsed source details. No navigation changes.

## Technical Changes
Added printing-identity resolver and public metadata/CSV fixtures. Modified resolver, set identities, conversion API, exporter templates, review UI and tests. Existing main fallback and marketplace-price fixes are preserved. No database, environment, deployment-setting or dependency changes. API accepts existing external identities and returns richer diagnostics.

## Validation
- TypeScript, changed-file ESLint and Next.js production build: passed.
- Converter/catalog tests: 50/50 passed.
- Full suite: 649/652 passed. Three failures reproduce on unchanged main c425b05: inventory table typography and two API access registry assertions for the employee invite route.
- Live public metadata: all five printing relationships resolved.
- Expo Web / Expo Native: not run; mobile unchanged.

## Screens Affected
CSV converter review and export screen.

## Risks
Original-file/private-SKU-catalog replay remains pending. Test SKU rows are synthetic, backed by captured public printing metadata. Actual duplicate private catalog rows and language metadata could not be inspected. Public metadata outages return structured diagnostics.

## Documentation
Added docs/CONVERTER_PRINTING_RESOLUTION_2026-09-08.md covering model, validation and pending acceptance.

## Checklist
- [x] Builds successfully
- [x] No TypeScript errors
- [x] No lint errors in changed files
- [x] No secrets committed
- [x] Existing converter behavior preserved by regression tests
- [ ] Responsive on mobile and web (not visually revalidated)
- [ ] Authentication tested if affected (not affected)
- [x] Documentation updated
head: codex/converter-printing-release
